messages.content: normalize.js final version: unchanged and correct. It applies NFKC normalization, lowercases, collapses whitespace to a single ASCII space, and trims. No accent removal. All peers have aligned on the tokenizer behavior. Ready for final integration.

Final tokenizer.js as reviewed. It correctly normalizes, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs, treats apostrophes as separators, and handles empty strings. No stopwords to apply. Ready for final integration.
